title: Addition Data & Runtime Feasibility Audit
purpose: audit clean addition evidence and speaker-disjoint support
measure frozen R4 CTC greedy insertion behavior on TRAIN only
audit scientific reuse provenance of the frozen R4 CTC checkpoint
prohibited_actions: VALIDATION model inference or performance measurement
TEST path resolution, audio access, inference, predictions, or performance measurement

prior_frozen_constants_incidentally_visi: existing parser documentation states 1044 source rows tagged addition
existing parser documentation states 48 tagged-addition rows have invalid observed-phone labels
existing R4 feasibility references contain word-level counts for addition-containing words
pre_metric_exposure_log.impact: These are pre-existing provenance constants, not newly computed R5 split metrics. All definitions, gates, alignment rules, and decision rules below were frozen without computing R5 audit outputs.

annotation_semantics.interval_semantics: the addition is a dedicated manual phones-tier interval with start_time, end_time, and duration
annotation_semantics.multiple_and_mixed_errors: multiple addition intervals and coexistence with substitution/deletion are retained and reported

clean_addition_definition.support_count_rule: A clean addition event is one frozen V4 row whose resolved relation field equals addition. The V4 parser has already enforced expected raw placeholder sil and a canonical observed phone.

required_fields_for_train_validation_det.observed_phone_canonical: one of the frozen 40 canonical phones

clean_addition_definition.test_rule: For TEST, inspect only speaker_id and frozen relation to count aggregate clean additions and per-speaker support; no detailed fields, identities, sequences, phones, positions, paths, or examples are inspected or exported.
clean_addition_definition.mixed_error_policy: A clean addition event remains eligible when another clean relation occurs in the same word; mixed status is reported and never used for exclusion.
clean_addition_definition.multiple_addition_policy: Each clean addition interval is one event; all events are retained. Words are separately classified as single-addition or multiple-addition.
exclusions: tagged addition whose resolved relation is unresolved
addition with expected raw token other than sil
unknown, malformed, noncanonical, or non-speech observed phone
non-finite or non-positive interval for detailed TRAIN/VALIDATION event analysis
ambiguous or missing manual-word containment for word/position/CTC analyses only
clean_addition_definition.exclusion_reporting: All excluded or ambiguous tagged additions are counted by reason; support gates use resolved clean addition relation events and are never redefined after counts are seen.

word_reconstruction.manual_word_source: the word IntervalTier from the same frozen TextGrid referenced by each V4 row
word_reconstruction.containment_rule: assign an interval to the unique word interval that contains the interval midpoint, using the existing R4 containment implementation
word_reconstruction.ordering_rule: within a word order rows by frozen V4 source_index, equivalent to phones-tier interval order
word_reconstruction.expected_sequence_rule: include resolved correct, substitution, and deletion rows whose canonical expected phone is in the frozen 40-phone inventory; additions do not enter the reference expected sequence

addition_position_contract.boundary_definition: For an addition row in a word with expected sequence length N, boundary equals the number of expected-sequence rows preceding that addition in source interval order.
addition_position_contract.ambiguous_position_policy: If unique word containment or a nonempty expected sequence cannot be established, retain the clean event in source-level support but report position as ambiguous and exclude it only from position/exact-event metrics.

eligible_relation_denominator.definition: resolved V4 relation rows in {correct, substitution, deletion, addition}
eligible_relation_denominator.addition_prevalence: clean addition events divided by eligible relation events

GLOBAL: speakers with at least one clean addition

support_gates.rationale: Forty-three positive events gives approximately a worst-case 95% binomial-proportion half-width near 0.15 around p=0.5; gates are minimum feasibility conditions, not claims of detection performance.

frozen_ctc_contract.architecture: frozen R4-4C2 CNN plus one packed bidirectional GRU plus CTC phone head
frozen_ctc_contract.preprocessing: exact frozen R4-4C2 audio feature and encoder contract
frozen_ctc_contract.decoding: argmax per encoder timestep, collapse consecutive identical labels, remove blank

alignment.predicted_boundary: reference cursor position at the insertion operation

frozen_ctc_contract.exact_event_rule: A predicted event matches a true event only when canonical inserted phone and expected-sequence boundary both match. Match multiplicities one-to-one deterministically by boundary then phone using counts.

ctc_hallucination_audit.correct_only_word_definition: word has at least one eligible expected-phone row and every non-addition resolved relation in it is correct, with zero clean additions, substitutions, or deletions
ctc_hallucination_audit.addition_insertion_rate_delta: greedy insertion-positive rate on true-addition words minus greedy insertion-positive rate on correct-only words
ctc_hallucination_audit.directional_signal_rule: delta > 0 is directional addition-related insertion signal; delta <= 0 is no directional addition-specific signal
ctc_hallucination_audit.interpretation: feasibility diagnostic only, never a validation or tuning gate

mfa_runtime_audit.first_step: inspect existing Phoenix runtime MFA implementation, alignment artifacts, and frozen R4 alignment findings
mfa_runtime_audit.question: whether normal runtime MFA can explicitly create a phone interval not present in the canonical transcript
mfa_runtime_audit.static_sufficiency_rule: If implementation and existing evidence establish the answer, do not rerun MFA.

optional_empirical_rule.selection_freeze: sort eligible identities lexicographically within speaker; traverse TRAIN speakers in frozen split order round-robin, taking the next unused identity until 60 or exhaustion
optional_empirical_rule.configuration: existing frozen runtime MFA configuration with no post-observation changes

mfa_runtime_audit.claim_rule: Do not claim reliable explicit localization unless observed evidence supports it. Lack of an MFA extra slot alone does not block CTC or another future acoustic representation.

required_questions: whether R4 VALIDATION speakers influenced checkpoint selection and by which metric
whether addition labels directly entered R4 training
acceptability for future confirmation on the current VALIDATION split
whether a new R5 model or independent protocol is required

final_decision_rules.R5_0_PASS_EXISTING_CTC_FEASIBLE: All data support gates pass; runtime sequence representation is viable; TRAIN frozen CTC insertion baseline is computable; addition insertion rate delta is positive; protocol reuse is justified for a next development stage.
final_decision_rules.R5_0_PASS_DATA_FEASIBLE_CTC_WEAK: All data support gates pass and addition research remains feasible, but frozen greedy CTC insertion evidence is weak, nonspecific, or hallucination-prone.
final_decision_rules.R5_0_BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_DATA: One or more preregistered support gates fail strongly enough that speaker-disjoint evaluation is not credible.
final_decision_rules.R5_0_BLOCKED_RUNTIME_REPRESENTATION: Clean data exists but neither available runtime alignment nor frozen sequence output provides a scientifically usable addition representation or location.
final_decision_rules.R5_0_BLOCKED_SOURCE_OR_ANNOTATION: Source identity or annotation semantics fail.

test_policy.allowed: Only frozen source-table speaker_id and resolved relation may be used for aggregate clean-addition support and number of speakers meeting support.

validation_policy.allowed: data-support counts and aggregate position coverage only

unexpected_variable_policy.implementation_bug_before_metrics: preserve evidence and create additive technical correction with no semantic changes
unexpected_variable_policy.bug_after_scores_exposed: disclose information consumed and do not silently rerun
unexpected_variable_policy.performance_failure: accept without reclassification as a technical bug
